text:
Maya: Quick idea — casual after-work on Thursday? Sunset karaoke + pints and a few ping-pong tables at The Dock Brewery. Anyone up for it? :microphone: :beer: :ping_pong:
Devin: love that. what time were you thinking?
Maya: aiming for ~6:30 meet in lobby, walk over. short place, easy to pop in.
Ellie: I can make 6:30. need a quieter corner tho, have a call earlier that day.
Ryan: in. happy to bring a tiny speaker if we need one. :guitar:
Manu: ping-pong or karaoke? i suck at both but i'm down. also can we have boardgames as backup?
Maya: venue has tables, so split works — some karaoke, some games/ping-pong.
Devin: should we reserve a table? they sometimes hold space for groups after 7pm.
Maya: good call — i can ping them. would anyone chip $5 for a small booking fee? saves standing room.
Ellie: I'll chip in.
Ryan: same. :money_with_wings:
ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands at 4pm Thursday. Please plan calendar accordingly.
Devin: noted, thanks ops-bot
Maya: also thinking a tiny photo challenge — best silly group pic wins coffee from the loser. :camera_with_flash:
Manu: vote on karaoke song list pls. i'll start: "Don't Stop Believin'"
Ellie: classic. i'll add "Levitating"
Devin: want to do a quick poll for time: 6pm / 6:30 / 7pm?
Maya: (quick tally) 6:30 wins so far — booking for 6:30 under "Redwood". DM me if you need to opt out.
Devin: sweet. tagging @Natalie — you love a good karaoke night.
Natalie: i'm in!! :sparkles: will bring a tiny prop hat for the winner.
Maya: perfect. i'll book and post confirmation. see y'all Thursday — casual clothes encouraged. :party_popper:
